name: India Property Register MCP
summary: MCP and API over Indian land and property records (plots, mutations, circle rates, RERA, auctions), with free starter credit then prepaid calls.
description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP at https://indiapropertyregister.com/mcp with OAuth 2.1 email-code sign-in (or API key). Tools include ask, search_places, get_village, find_plot, get_plot, search_owner, get_village_rates, city property and deed lookups, list_auctions, RERA tools, get_wallet and top_up_wallet. Pages are free to read and cite; API/MCP are prepaid (₹50 free credit on signup, then ₹0.40 per successful call). Connect guide at /connect; auth.md for agent signup.

agent_access.notes: OAuth 2.1 or Bearer API key. Protected-resource metadata at indiapropertyregister.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp.
